business_problem: St. Joseph's Health needed to overcome fragmented EHR, payer, and community data that made it hard for clinicians to close care gaps, coordinate care across sites, and manage value-based reimbursement effectively.
solution_summary: St. Joseph's Health extended its Oracle Health Foundation EHR with Oracle Health Quality Management, Oracle Health Care Coordination Intelligence, and Oracle Health AI Data Platform to create a longitudinal patient data foundation for care management. The Oracle stack consolidates records from the health system, third-party care settings, payer feeds, and community sources into a single view that clinicians can use inside daily workflows. Quality management and care coordination services help teams identify open care gaps, standardize interventions, and target high-risk patients, while the AI data platform brings analytics and context into those workflows so physicians see relevant information when they need it. Because the system unifies previously disconnected records and automates care-management processes, St. Joseph's can intervene earlier on chronic conditions, support value-based reimbursement, and run targeted readmission programs using the same Oracle Health data backbone.

solution_components.name: Oracle Health Foundation EHR
solution_components.role: Provides the baseline clinical record system that St. Joseph's extended with analytics and coordination services.

solution_components.name: Oracle Health Quality Management
solution_components.role: Supports care-gap identification and quality-focused intervention workflows.

solution_components.name: Oracle Health Care Coordination Intelligence
solution_components.role: Coordinates inpatient and outpatient care-management processes around a unified patient view.

solution_components.name: Oracle Health AI Data Platform
solution_components.role: Consolidates data from EHR, payer, and community sources and powers analytics for proactive care management.

data_flow: Clinical, payer, and community data is consolidated through Oracle Health AI Data Platform and linked to Oracle Health Foundation EHR records; Quality Management and Care Coordination Intelligence use that longitudinal record to surface care gaps, identify high-risk patients, and guide interventions within clinician workflows.
business_outcome: St. Joseph's Health unified patient data across care settings, gave clinicians a longitudinal patient view to close care gaps faster, automated care-management processes, and sustained congestive-heart-failure readmission rates below the market average for three consecutive years.
metrics: Readmission rate for a targeted congestive heart failure program remained below the market average for three consecutive years
